selection.edition: international AgentMail API v0 at api.agentmail.to
selection.ownership: AgentMail (YC S25), San Francisco, California. International email-inbox API at api.agentmail.to; EU host api.agentmail.eu is a separate edition and is not exposed.

research.searchCoverage: Official AgentMail v0 authentication (Authorization Bearer), GET /v0/auth/me, GET /v0/inboxes, GET /v0/inboxes/{inbox_id}, GET /v0/inboxes/{inbox_id}/messages, GET /v0/inboxes/{inbox_id}/messages/{message_id}, San Francisco YC S25 identity, and dated incident search (AgentMail + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Status-page sending outages and a Halloween-hackathon domain-resemblance demo are recorded; no current unresolved AgentMail API platform compromise was identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international AgentMail API v0 at api.agentmail.to
research.searchCoverage: Official AgentMail API v0 at https://api.agentmail.to with Authorization Bearer was confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is AgentMail (YC S25) in San Francisco. GET /v0/auth/me, inbox list/get, and inbox message list/get match pinned source. EU api.agentmail.eu, x402, and mpp hosts are separate editions and are not exposed. Status-page email-sending outages (2026-08-19, 2026-09-09) are availability events. A 2025 Halloween-hackathon demo of lookalike agent.to addresses is a product-design phishing concern, not a confirmed AgentMail API data breach. GitHub advisory GHSA-wjjv-3mj2-39hf is a different product (agenticmail). Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.affectedData: No AgentMail customer-data compromise identified; demo showed lookalike agent.to addresses that could be used for phishing.
incidents.status: historical product-design concern; not a confirmed API platform breach
incidents.remediation: No vendor platform-compromise disclosure was identified in this 2026-09-13 review; AgentMail documents inbox isolation, rate limits, and send allowlists.
incidents.residualRisk: Lookalike-address phishing remains a general email-identity risk; live authentication unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
